summary: Eren meets the Armored Titan at arm's length. The corps fights armor with strike, throw, and lock. The capture still fails.

segments.ja: 壁から落ちた戦いは、地面の近接になります。近接では、エレンの拳と鎧の巨人の腕が同じ視野に入ります。入った視野は、森の捕獲作戦より個人的です。個人的である理由は、相手の中身の名前を知っているからです。知っている名前が、拳の速度を一度乱します。乱れた速度を、エレンは裏切りへの怒りで戻そうとします。戻す怒りは、技術より先に出ます。先に出た怒りは、鎧にはまだ通用しません。通用しない怒りを、彼は技術へ変換し始めます。
segments.en: The fight that fell from the wall becomes close combat on the ground. In the close range, Eren's fist and the Armored Titan's arm enter the same field of view. The field of view is more personal than the capture operation in the forest. The reason it is personal is that he knows the name of the contents. The name he knows disrupts the fist's speed once. He tries to bring the disrupted speed back with anger at the betrayal. The anger he brings back comes out ahead of technique. Anger that comes out ahead still does not work on armor. He starts to convert the anger that does not work into technique.

segments.ja: 調査兵団の刃は、普通の巨人のうなじには届きます。届く刃が、鎧の表面では滑ります。滑ることを、ミカサは一度で理解し、関節の薄い場所へ目標を変えます。変えた目標は、首そのものではなく、動きを止める部分です。部分を止めるには、切るだけでは足りません。足りない切るを、打つ、投げる、極める、という三つの動作が補います。三つの動作は、個人の英雄談ではなく、班の手順です。
segments.en: The Survey Corps' blades reach an ordinary Titan's nape. The blades that reach slide on the surface of armor. Mikasa understands the sliding in one pass and changes the target to the thin places at the joints. The changed target is not the neck itself. It is the part that stops movement. Cutting alone is not enough to stop the part. Three motions fill in the cutting that is not enough: strike, throw, and lock. The three motions are not one person's hero story. They are a squad's procedure.

segments.en: In the middle of the fight, the word surrender flies. The flying word is both a demand from the armor's side and a shout from this side. Either way, Reiner does not put the mission down. Toward an opponent who will not put it down, Eren cannot help expecting a human stop. The expectation comes from the memory of a body put on the line at the tower. The expectation that came delays the fist again. Mikasa's blade fills the hole of the delayed fist. Even filling it, the contents of the armor do not stop.

segments.ja: 打つは、硬い面に力を集めてヒビを入れる動作です。入れる場所を誤ると、自分の拳が先に割れます。エレンは一度、その誤りを体で支払います。支払ったあと、彼はミカサの示す薄い線へ打ち直します。打ち直した線が、鎧の動きをわずかに鈍くします。鈍った動きは、勝利ではありません。勝利の前の、次の動作のための隙間です。隙間を、班は投げる準備に使います。
segments.en: To strike is to gather force on a hard surface and put a crack in it. If the place is wrong, your own fist cracks first. Eren pays for that mistake once, with his body. After paying, he strikes again along the thin line Mikasa indicates. The line he strikes again dulls the armor's movement slightly. Dulled movement is not victory. It is a gap, before victory, for the next motion. The squad uses the gap to prepare a throw.

segments.en: To throw is to put the opponent's weight onto your own path. To put it there, you need the moment when the armor's foot leaves the ground. Blades and Eren's body make that needed moment together. In the moment they make, the Titan's huge body collapses, and destruction of the ground spreads. The spreading destruction takes in the city's buildings. Hannes watches the taking-in from the residents' side. Watching, he cannot yet enter this fight fully. The position of not entering leaves his later role.

segments.ja: ハンネスは、この近接の中心にはいません。いないことが、彼を無力にはしません。住民を蒸気から離し、崩れた道を開けることが、今日の彼の戦闘です。戦闘は地味です。地味な戦闘が、後でエレンの隣に彼が立つ理由を残します。残る理由を、本人はまだ知りません。知らないまま、彼はシガンシナから続く顔で現場にいます。いる顔が、エレンの母の記憶と無意識に繋がっています。
segments.en: Hannes is not at the center of this close combat. Not being there does not make him powerless. Getting residents away from the steam and opening a collapsed road is his fight today. The fight is plain. The plain fight leaves the reason he will later stand beside Eren. He himself does not yet know the reason that remains. Not knowing it, he is at the scene with the face that has continued from Shiganshina. The face that is there connects, without his intending it, to the memory of Eren's mother.

segments.en: Christa is not inside the warriors' arms. Not being inside remains as part of Ymir's calculation. She, who remained, watches the direction Eren is carried. segments.en: By the time the target of the attack has been passed to the whole unit, the armor has already shifted its weight outward. Pursuit after the shift is hard to reach even at ODM speed. The reason it is hard to reach is that steam refuses the wires. The squad that was refused returns to the ground and counts the injured. Counting is a check of who is alive, for the next hunt. The center column of the check is Eren. The column being empty is the body of today's defeat.

segments.ja: 打って、投げて、極める。三つの手順は間違っていません。間違っていない手順が、超大型の介入で時間を失いました。失った時間を、誰かの不手際として片づけることはできません。できない整理を、アルミンは自分の伝達の遅れとしても抱えません。抱えない代わりに、次に必要なのは追う隊だと置きます。置く顔は、友人を失った顔です。失った顔のまま、彼は方角を西の外へ向けます。
segments.en: Strike, throw, lock. The three procedures are not wrong. The procedures that are not wrong lost their time to the Colossal's intervention. The lost time cannot be tidied away as someone's clumsiness. Armin does not also hold the untidyable sorting as a delay in his own message. Instead of holding it, he sets down that what is needed next is a squad that pursues. The face that sets it down is the face of someone who has lost a friend. vocab.exampleJa: 伝える声は、友人を殺す手順の声です。
vocab.exampleEn: From outside the close combat, Armin sees the whole. What he sees is not only Eren's fist. It is Bertholdt's position. If that position is preparing steam, a victory on this ground becomes void in the next moment. Before it becomes void, the contents have to be pulled out of the armor. He tells Mikasa the necessity, briefly. The voice that tells it is the voice of a procedure for killing a friend. He hides the pain of the voice. The hidden pain is the price of a diagram being correct.

vocab.exampleJa: 変えたルールでは、関節を極める時間そのものが蒸気に溶けます。
vocab.exampleEn: When the three motions on the ground have nearly stopped the armor, the Colossal's mass appears nearby. The mass that appears changes the rules of the fight. Under the changed rules, the time itself for locking a joint dissolves into steam. Inside the dissolved time, Eren's body is secured in the armor's arm. The securing is the shape of a defeat. The Survey Corps does not admit the shape at once. While they do not admit it, the two Titans shift their weight toward the outside of the wall. The shifted weight settles the failure of the capture.

vocab.exampleJa: 乗せるには、鎧の足が地面から離れる瞬間が要ります。
vocab.exampleEn: To throw is to put the opponent's weight onto your own path. To put it there, you need the moment when the armor's foot leaves the ground. Blades and Eren's body make that needed moment together. In the moment they make, the Titan's huge body collapses, and destruction of the ground spreads. The spreading destruction takes in the city's buildings. Hannes watches the taking-in from the residents' side. Watching, he cannot yet enter this fight fully. The position of not entering leaves his later role.

vocab.exampleJa: 期待は、塔で体を張った記憶から来ます。
vocab.exampleEn: In the middle of the fight, the word surrender flies. The flying word is both a demand from the armor's side and a shout from this side. Either way, Reiner does not put the mission down. Toward an opponent who will not put it down, Eren cannot help expecting a human stop. The expectation comes from the memory of a body put on the line at the tower. The expectation that came delays the fist again. Mikasa's blade fills the hole of the delayed fist. Even filling it, the contents of the armor do not stop.

vocab.exampleJa: 確認の中心の欄は、エレン、です。
vocab.exampleEn: By the time the target of the attack has been passed to the whole unit, the armor has already shifted its weight outward. Pursuit after the shift is hard to reach even at ODM speed. The reason it is hard to reach is that steam refuses the wires. The squad that was refused returns to the ground and counts the injured. Counting is a check of who is alive, for the next hunt. The center column of the check is Eren. The column being empty is the body of today's defeat.

vocab.exampleJa: 乱れた速度を、エレンは裏切りへの怒りで戻そうとします。
vocab.exampleEn: The fight that fell from the wall becomes close combat on the ground. In the close range, Eren's fist and the Armored Titan's arm enter the same field of view. The field of view is more personal than the capture operation in the forest. The reason it is personal is that he knows the name of the contents. The name he knows disrupts the fist's speed once. He tries to bring the disrupted speed back with anger at the betrayal. The anger he brings back comes out ahead of technique. Anger that comes out ahead still does not work on armor. He starts to convert the anger that does not work into technique.

vocab.exampleJa: 選択は冷たく見えます。
vocab.exampleEn: Mikasa moves at a distance that includes Eren's delay in the calculation. The blade that moves does not stop even knowing Reiner's face. Not stopping is not an absence of mercy. It is the choice that keeps Eren alive. The choice looks cold. The choice that looks cold is the correct speed today. Even at the correct speed, the armor does not fully crack. Inside the armor that does not crack, Reiner still does not let go of the mission. The will that does not let go is the limit of the three motions.
